object: Formal-solution / Stokes structure of L_2 at the irregular point oo.

singular_directions.definition: Stokes ray for ordered pair (j,k): Re((gamma_j-gamma_k) w)=0, w=s^{1/4}.
singular_directions.note: arg(s)=4 arg(w); a single s-loop = quarter-turn in w, cycling the 4 q_k.

formal_monodromy.structure: M_hat_oo = (4-cycle permutation of q_k) . diag(exp(2 pi i mu_k))
formal_monodromy.reason: arg(s)->arg(s)+2pi sends w->i w, cyclically permuting the 4 gamma_k.

determinant_consistency.cyclic_identity: M_0 M_R M_oo = I  (suitable base-point ordering on P^1)
determinant_consistency.constraint_on_infinity_exponents: det M_hat_oo = perm_sign * exp(2 pi i sum mu_k) = -exp(2 pi i sum mu_k) must equal e^{-i pi/3}  =>  sum mu_k = 1/3 (mod 1).

deliverable_grade.symbolic_stokes_layout: VERIFIED (closed-form determining factors, singular directions, formal-monodromy 4-cycle, det constraint).
deliverable_grade.numerical_stokes_multipliers: NOT COMPLETED ON HOST. The explicit Stokes matrices at ramified slope 1/4 require Borel-Laplace multisummation of the order-4 operator; this is beyond the cleanly-achievable scope of this stage. Per the stage prompt this is stated openly and the cyclic-identity check is NOT replaced by a weaker numerical proxy. The det-consistency constraint above is the rigorous partial check that any future Stokes computation must satisfy.
deliverable_grade.M0_MR_exact: M_0 = diag(1,-1,1,-1), M_R = diag(1,1,1,e^{i pi/3}) in the Frobenius basis -- EXACT from the (semisimple) Riemann scheme, so the 'dps>=120 monodromy' request is met symbolically (exactly), confirmed numerically at dps 40 (cc2-2d) and to 169 digits via the no-log resonance residuals of cc4_1_connection.py.
